Synthetic fixture text. Use [`LazyColumn`](/reference/kotlin/androidx/compose/foundation/lazy/LazyColumn.composable.md.txt#LazyColumn(androidx.compose.ui.Modifier,kotlin.Function1)) for long lists and [state](/develop/ui/compose/state.md.txt) for data.

<br />

## Lazy lists

A `LazyColumn` composes only the visible items.

```kotlin
LazyColumn {
    items(messages, key = { it.id }) { message -> MessageRow(message) }
}
```

> [!NOTE]
> **Note:** keys keep item state stable across reorders. See [the guide](https://example.invalid/off-site).

## Item keys

Provide a stable `key` for each item.

> [!NOTE]
> **Note:** If you've used the [`RecyclerView`
> widget](/reference/androidx/recyclerview/widget/RecyclerView.md.txt), the same rules apply.
